rationale: Retain measured closure locations, fully closed command intervals, post-closure open command intervals, and the releasing arm's closure-to-release vertical rise with a local release-height constraint. These describe the observed two-arm handover using reference envelopes, not object contact or physical feasibility. Select arms symmetrically. Recipient-only terminal height is omitted because the selector language cannot select an arm by its event history. No orientation or speed requirement is inferred.

rules.rationale: Preserve each EEF's measured location at its own closure crossing, for initial pickup and reception. The fixed measured origin is not an object-frame grasp center or a calibrated grasp region.
Retain fully closed reference command plateaus after acquisition and reception. Gripper fraction does not measure contact, force, aperture in metres, or successful retention.
Retain the releasing arm's fully open command plateau after its prior closure. Initial approach with an open gripper is outside this selection.

Measure the releasing EEF's net world-vertical rise from its own first closure to its release crossing. This is an end-of-carry displacement, not object lift or an intermediate path restriction; training requires the original closure anchor inside the chunk.

Retain the releasing EEF's measured world height at the release crossing as local elevated-handover geometry when the earlier displacement anchor is outside a training chunk. This is not table clearance or object support geometry.
